collections.name: Haunted Love
collections.shortDescription: Love stories that linger beyond time...
collections.fullDescription: Some love stories never truly fade. Haunted Love celebrates memories, devotion and affection that continue to echo long after moments have passed. Every treasure in this collection carries a quiet reminder that love can leave lasting footprints.

collections.name: Enchanted Forest
collections.shortDescription: Woodland magic hidden beneath ancient trees...
collections.fullDescription: Step beneath ancient branches where hidden paths, moss-covered stones and whispered folklore meet. These treasures are inspired by quiet forests, forgotten trails and the gentle magic of nature.

collections.name: Little Miracles
collections.shortDescription: Small reminders that hope can bloom in unexpected places.
collections.fullDescription: Not every miracle arrives with fanfare. Sometimes they're found in quiet moments, gentle encouragement, or the courage to keep moving forward one step at a time. The Little Miracles collection celebrates resilience, hope and the beauty of finding light after darkness. Each treasure is a reminder that even the smallest spark can make a difference.

collections.name: Forgotten Treasures
collections.fullDescription: Hidden beneath dust and time lie stories waiting to be uncovered. Forgotten Treasures is a growing collection of mysterious relics, ancient secrets and curious discoveries that continue to expand as new treasures are found.
